title: Balanced default
summary: Broad starter pack for a student with little pre-existing knowledge.
target_user: minimal prior knowledge, wants broad coverage
notes: Includes most high-priority snippets, all default-selected pieces, and a few clarifiers for recurring exact exam patterns.

title: Post-midterm tilted
summary: Weights strings, pandas, datetime, and OOP while still keeping a small pre-midterm rescue layer.
target_user: expects the final to skew toward later-course material
notes: Good default when space is tight but you still want coverage for the most likely post-midterm traps.

title: Ultra-dense core
summary: Only the highest-yield snippets and their default-selected pieces.
target_user: very limited space, wants maximum points per line
notes: Best for students who already remember the basics and want a compact safety net.

title: Trap hunter
summary: Focused on the recurrent wrong-answer patterns and elimination traps.
target_user: knows the material somewhat, mainly loses points to subtle distractors
notes: Emphasizes mutation-vs-return, pandas shape traps, scope, parse/format, and method-call gotchas.

title: Max coverage V2
summary: Broadest pack: high-yield core plus the legacy backup material integrated in V2.
target_user: wants the fullest reference pack, including lower-frequency corner cases
notes: Includes all default-selected pieces plus selected backup clarifiers from the legacy dataset integration pass.
